reason: The hypothesis synthesizes several known phenomena—SRO-enhanced pinning, SRO disruption by dislocations, and nano-twin nucleation at boundaries—into a new, cyclic mechanism (pinning → SRO breakdown → nano-twin–mediated recovery) operating at multilayer interfaces under creep, which no single passage proposes or studies. It transfers the idea of SRO-governed deformation from bulk MEAs/HEAs to the specific context of nanoscale multilayer coatings and links it to a progressive creep response, going beyond the individual findings.
